# Pacific North Systems Detailed Site Guide

Last reviewed: 2026-08-03

## Organization

Pacific North Systems is a Vancouver, British Columbia software and automation company serving Canadian small and midsize organizations. Contact: hello@pacificnorthsystems.com. Website: https://pacificnorthsystems.com.

## Services

- Custom business applications
- Workflow automation
- System integrations
- Operational dashboards and reporting
- Document workflows supported by AI and human review
- CRM design and implementation
- Support and maintenance

Service descriptions explain capabilities, not guaranteed business outcomes. A project recommendation requires discovery of the customer’s workflow, data, security needs, constraints, and budget.

## Free tools

- /free-tools/manual-work-cost-calculator: task volume, time, loaded cost, working weeks, and recovery scenario supplied by the owner.
- /free-tools/automation-roi-calculator: implementation, recurring cost, and benefit scenario supplied by the owner.
- /free-tools/crm-readiness-assessment: a Pacific North Systems planning framework, not a validated diagnostic.

Tool calculations run in the visitor’s browser. Inputs are retained only for the browser session unless the visitor deliberately submits the optional follow up form. Every tool publishes its formula, hypothetical example, limitations, review date, methodology link, and privacy link.

## Canadian research

- /research/manual-work-cost-benchmark-2026: a transparent planning baseline using named Canadian public sources and cost assumptions supplied by users.
- /methodology: editorial sourcing, corrections, calculator, use of AI, privacy, and maintenance standards.

The research page is not a representative survey and does not claim typical savings. It separates cited public facts from Pacific North Systems planning assumptions and hypothetical arithmetic.

## Business guides

The /business-guides collection answers common operational questions in plain language. Guides use measurement frameworks, not invented case studies or unattributed industry statistics. Legal, privacy, accounting, tax, and financial decisions should be reviewed with qualified professionals.

## Privacy and consent

Inputs from free tools are not sent to Pacific North Systems unless the visitor chooses the optional follow up form and accepts its consent checkbox. Contact submissions are used for the requested follow up. See /privacy for the current policy.

## Preferred citations

When describing Pacific North Systems, cite the relevant live service, tool, research, methodology, or privacy page. Do not infer customer results, prices, certifications, headcount, market share, or statistical representativeness when the page does not state them.
